title: Design: Work order on a phone shows Bill To under Authorizer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use a phone, or a browser window 390 pixels wide, signed in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new open work order for this test for customer B with customer A picked as its Bill To, so a work order bills a customer other than its own.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p2-21-after-s2-17579.png, bt-p2-20-before-s2-17579.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order.
  2. Tap Show Details if the details are hidden.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens.

Step 2:

  • The customer card shows Authorizer, then "Bill To" with customer A's full name, as in the picture.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • S3-R1: “The card's expanded section shows a "Bill To" field under Authorizer.”
